label: Feature launch
description: A new or expanded capability that overlaps with ours, or a change an IT admin will notice in a rollout.
example: A provisioning change that affects how users get added from Okta or Entra ID.

label: Pricing / packaging change
description: Per-user prices, seat minimums, and which plan a feature sits on. We record what the page says and never estimate a price.
example: SSO moved from the top plan to the middle plan.

label: Comparison claim / messaging
description: New claims about LastPass, new target buyers, or new headlines. Comparison pages get read line by line.
example: A competitor's LastPass page adds a line about our certifications.

label: Security model or certification
description: Encryption changes, audits, certifications, and incident disclosures. These get a second review before anything reaches a rep.
example: A competitor announces a new certification or changes its encryption.

label: AI and agent access
description: Features for AI agents, or AI inside the product.
example: A competitor gives AI agents scoped access to credentials.

label: Analyst recognition
description: Analyst reports and rankings that buyers quote in evaluations.
example: A competitor is named in an analyst quadrant.

label: Review theme
description: Recurring praise or complaints from IT admins and end users on public review sites.
example: Several reviews mention a hard first-week rollout.

label: MSP or partner change
description: Changes to how a competitor sells through managed service providers.
example: A competitor adds multi-tenant billing for MSPs.

label: Win-loss / call mention
description: What buyers and reps tell us. Internal, so it carries no public citation.
example: A security lead raised the 2022 incident in three first calls this week.
